# Workstream plan

> **Status:** Active, paused, or complete; include a verification date when the
> state depends on an external fact.
>
> **Canonical gap:** Link to the maintained evidence or status owner that
> establishes why this plan exists.

## Objective

Define the concrete capability or decision the workstream will deliver.

## Non-goals

Name adjacent work that this plan deliberately does not own.

## Phases

| Phase | Exit evidence | Dependencies | State |
|-------|---------------|--------------|-------|
| 1 | Smallest result that closes this phase. | Required source, artifact, hardware, or prior proof. | Planned. |

Link scoped child plans or runbooks instead of copying their detailed steps.

## Dependencies and risks

Record cross-project sequencing, recovery constraints, evidence gaps, and
assumptions that could invalidate the plan.

## Public/private boundary

State whether the work touches upstream submission planning, vulnerability or
CVE coordination, or a memory-corruption reproducer. Keep those materials in
the private `rock-5b-security` repository and retain only the public engineering
record here.

## Definition of done

List the measured outcomes, artifact identities, status update, durable evidence
owners, and cleanup required before this plan can close.
